column2: and parts of the VLAN tag. But this

suspect 0xfffe0000 was intended to test reserved part only.
Finally
column2: this hunk is evil as it can cause more packets to be

column1: handled than what was NAPI quota causing net/core/dev.c:

mess up the NAPI state causing device to hang.
As result
column2: any system using VLANs and having high receive

column1: traffic (so that NAPI poll budget limits rtl_rx) would result
in device hang.
